Resolve the Elfsworn Giant from step 4, creating a token.

When Ghost Town enters, Elfsworn Giant triggers.

650-3175-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Repeat.

Repeat.

Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

5477-6633-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
5477-6633-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
5477-6633-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

5477-7297-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.

5477-7297-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

Repeat.

489-2034-5224-6294.description:
Cast Marketback Walker by paying {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Marketback Walker.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Marketback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Marketback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Marketback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3991-4605-5256-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {4}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Faceless Butcher and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Faceless Butcher trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Faceless Butcher that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Faceless Butcher token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Faceless Butcher.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Faceless Butcher token
When the Faceless Butcher token dies, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1876-5702-6753.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
1876-5702-6753.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Nissa, Worldwaker
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

232-1235-2239-5940.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Return the Favor by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Ardent Elementalist.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Ardent Elementalist with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Ardent Elementalist tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Ardent Elementalist trigger, returning Return the Favor from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

342-5189-5776.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
342-5189-5776.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {0} due to Sam and Ygra and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {0} and sacrificing the Saproling.
When the Saproling dies as a Food due to Ygra, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Ghave ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
342-5189-5776.notes: You can either remove the counter placed on Ghave or a counter from Ygra to continue the loop. The combo results in infinite +1/+1 counters that Ghave can remove for Saprolings and/or to place counters on other creature(s).

3108-5330-6972--112.description:
If Grim Poppet has any -1/-1 counters on it, activate it by removing a -1/-1 counter from it.
Repeat step 1 as necessary until Grim Poppet has no -1/-1 counters on it.
Activate Atog by sacrificing Grim Poppet.
When Grim Poppet dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.
Resolve all Grim Poppet abilities, putting infinite -1/-1 counters on any number of creatures.
3108-5330-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost toughness by at least 1 to prevent Grim Poppet from dying due to the -1/-1 counters. You can perform this combo as a lock whenever a creature enters the battlefield to put -1/-1 counters on that creature and cause it to die.

Activate Strands of Night by paying {B}{B} and 2 life and sacrificing a Swamp, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aftermath Analyst enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Repeat.

When Arid Archway enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.

Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.

Repeat.

3188-4186-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.

The opponent will then lose the game during their next end step due to Glorious End's triggered ability.

3129-5478-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.

When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Spelunking
Repeat from step 3.

1309-2103-2665.notablePrerequisites:
